proposals.trigger: Before implementing an inference optimization candidate
proposals.changed_action: Estimate its recoverable non-overlapped wall-time against the remaining target gap and verify the exact pinned runtime path
proposals.verification: Candidate record contains opportunity bound, exact runtime source identity, per-process activation proof, and negative-off evidence

proposals.trigger: After a candidate stalls, times out, or fails before producing a benchmark result
proposals.changed_action: Record the exact bytes and failure phase, close unchanged retries, and require a successor experiment to target that phase
proposals.verification: Closed-route ledger and phase markers show that any successor changed both hypothesis and test

proposals.trigger: When operator or profiler evidence is used to predict service performance
proposals.changed_action: Use critical-path or union time, covered call fraction, and an E2E impact bound rather than summed overlapping durations
proposals.verification: Evidence packet separates per-call delta, covered calls, overlap, maximum E2E benefit, and observed service result

proposals.trigger: When validating a custom multi-rank collective candidate
proposals.changed_action: Prove chip-route support, lifecycle balance, fresh epochs, restart safety, progress, timeouts, and all-rank error propagation before E2E
proposals.verification: Bounded multi-rank canary records phase markers and completes repeated fresh-process restart trials

proposals.trigger: When a host safety gate sees container device declarations
proposals.changed_action: Distinguish running active claims from exited historical provenance unless the user explicitly requires any declaration to block
proposals.verification: Occupancy report includes container state and states whether the default or stricter policy was applied
